title: Sri Lankan hospital length of stay (synthetic)
provenance: Synthetic Sri Lankan-context data generated by scripts/generate_samples.py (seed 42)
description: One row per hospital admission with demographics, diagnosis group and admission-time lab values, with the length of stay in days as the target.
context: Uses Sri Lankan districts, hospital tiers (Teaching, Provincial General, Base, District General, Divisional, Private), LKR billing and diagnoses common locally such as dengue and CKD/CKDu. No real hospital or patient is represented.

features.ckd_stage: CKD stage 1-5; missing when not CKD
features.total_bill_lkr: Total bill in LKR, known only after discharge (LEAKAGE)

target_definition: length_of_stay_days = whole days between admission and discharge.
known_limitations: Synthetic data: relationships are simulated, not clinical findings.
total_bill_lkr is a planted leakage column and must be excluded.
Not suitable for any clinical decision making.
anonymisation: Not applicable; no real patients are represented.
